title: Jujutsu Kaisen Movie: Shibuya Jihen Tokubetsu Henshuu-ban x Shimetsu Kaiyuu Senkou Jouei
content:
If there is a type of movies I dislike, it’s this one.
Nothing interesting to see here folks, especially now that it’s been rendered obsolete.
Unlike movie 1, where you get a complete and to the point recap of the Hidden Inventory arc, this movie is just a borderline TikTok recap of season 2’s second half and the first two episodes of season 3 bundled in.

Now that season 3 has finished airing, the biggest appeal of this movie has been rendered obsolete in my eyes. You can just go ahead and watch the third season properly instead. As for season 2’s compilation, let’s be honest. You’re betteroff watching them on YouTube, with arguably better editing and composition.

Overall: 6.8/10.
